description: This file implements the MediaFrameWriterV2 class, which handles writing media frame data and associated metadata into shared memory buffers, including serialization of metadata using protobuf, and conversion functions for media segment attributes.

classes.name: MediaFrameWriterV2
classes.description: A class responsible for writing media frames and their metadata into shared memory buffers, supporting serialization and metadata management.

methods.name: MediaFrameWriterV2::writeFrame
methods.description: Writes a media segment into shared memory, serializing its metadata and data, and handling memory constraints.

methods.name: MediaFrameWriterV2::buildMetadata
methods.description: Constructs protobuf metadata for a given media segment, including media-specific attributes and encryption info.
